_comment: Modules that are deliberately not started. The runner already skips OpenID4VP modules that the suite parks in WAITING (wallet handoff) without listing them here - that is detected from the suite status and reported as handoff=true. Use this file for modules that must never be attempted, for example interactive flows with no stubbed wallet.
_handoff: See docs/handoff.md. A handoff skip does not fail the gate unless failOnHandoff is set in benchmark.json.
